historical_notebook_baseline.explanation: Original group notebook split all 114,000 raw rows without deduplicating track_id. Because 24,259 rows are multi-genre duplicates of existing track_ids, identical songs leaked across train and test sets.

pre_patch_pipeline_prototype.explanation: Early pipeline prototype used to_sql(if_exists='append'), doubling the 89,740 rows to 179,480 on rerun and leaking identical tracks across train/test.

baseline_source: Deduplicated leakage-free holdout evaluation (89,740 unique track_ids: 71,792 train / 17,948 test). Verified via ablation study in outputs/ablation_study.json.
